articles.description: The brand's 38 physical stores and online site will continue to operate while receivers review its operations.

articles.title: Interest rates expected to rise for first time in over three years
articles.description: Most analysts are predicting an increase from 3.75% to 4%, the first increase in more than three years.
articles.summary: Policymakers at the Bank of England are expected to raise interest rates on Thursday in what would be the first increase to the benchmark rate for more than three years.
key_points: Most analysts are predicting an rise from 3.75% to 4% in a move that would increase the cost of borrowing for individuals and businesses, but boost savers.
The Bank rate has fallen from its 2023-24 peak of 5.25%, although the Bank's Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) has left the rate unchanged at its last six meetings.
Rising inflation, driven primarily by the cost of petrol and diesel, will push policymakers into an interest rate hike, analysts suggest.

key_points: Sterling has risen notably in recent weeks against the euro and the dollar, ahead of an expected rise in interest rates.

The most-watched measure of the value of the British currency against a basket of 18 of the world's main currencies this week reached its joint highest level since the June 2016 referendum, according…
The value reached 86.4 on an index where 100 equals the value in 2005.

Musk spent at least $45m in support of Paxton, according to a BBC analysis of campaign finance data .

articles.title: Poundland owner in crunch talks as retailer's collapse looms
articles.description: Gordon Brothers will meet Jonathan Reynolds on Wednesday as the investment firm faces scrutiny over Poundland.
articles.summary: Business Secretary Jonathan Reynolds will meet the US-based owners of Poundland on Wednesday as the government hopes to save the retailer from collapse.
key_points: The discount chain is on the brink of insolvency and Gordon Brothers, which bought it for £1 last June, has rejected a takeover bid which could have saved the 12,000 jobs currently at…
A meeting was due to be held on Thursday but has been brought forward as the scramble to secure a rescue deal for the firm intensifies.
Gordon Brothers has previously said Poundland faces multiple economic challenges from rising inflation, increasing staff costs, and "severe levels of shoplifting".

articles.title: Kellogg's admits snap, crackle and pop is quieter after uproar over Rice Krispies recipe change
articles.description: The cereal giant has changed the recipes for Rice Krispies and Coco Pops, sparking a backlash online.
articles.summary: Kellogg's has told the BBC the "snap, crackle and pop" sound made by its Rice Krispies may be noticeably quieter after an uproar over the cereal giant's recipe change.
key_points: Rice Krispies and Coco Pops are no longer being made with whole rice grains, with the tiny toasted puffs being made using corn flour and rice flour instead.
A Kellogg's spokesperson said retaining the iconic sound had been a "huge focus" when designing the new recipe, but that customers "might notice that the sound may be quieter and not as instant…
The firm was responding to complaints online that the taste of the breakfast staples had changed, with some fans adding they missed the "pop" sound.
